map.MD5 (Message-Digest Algorithm 5) 输出128位(: MD5 (Message-Digest Algorithm 5) produces a 128-bit (32-character) hash. ⚠️ It has been shown to be vulnerable to collisions, so do not use it for security; it is only suitable for things like file verification.
map.计算输入的 MD5 消息摘要。: Compute the MD5 message digest of your input.
map.：128 位摘要，通常表示为 32 位十六进制字符串。: : a 128-bit digest, usually written as a 32-character hexadecimal string.
map.：填充至 512 位的整数倍，分块进行 4 轮共 64 步的位运算。: : pad the message to a multiple of 512 bits, then process it in blocks through 4 rounds of 64 bitwise operations.
map.：MD5 的碰撞已被实际攻破，不可用于数字签名、证书与口令存储。: : MD5 collisions have been broken in practice, so it must not be used for digital signatures, certificates, or password storage.

map.MD5 还能用于安全吗？: Can MD5 still be used for security?
map.不建议，已被碰撞攻破，仅用于非安全完整性校验。: Not recommended. Its collisions have been broken, so use it only for non-security integrity checks.
map.MD5 和 CRC32 有什么不同？: How does MD5 differ from CRC32?
map.CRC32 是为检测信道误码设计的，只有 32 位、碰撞极易构造；MD5 是密码: CRC32 was designed to detect transmission errors: it is only 32 bits and collisions are trivial to construct. MD5 is a cryptographic hash, 128 bits, originally designed to resist collisions. Although MD5 has been broken and can no longer be used for security, as a checksum in a non-adversarial setting its error-detection capability still beats CRC32.
map.免费在线MD5加密工具，生成字符串的MD5哈希值，支持批量生成，MD5碰撞检测参: A free online MD5 hash calculator that computes 128-bit (32-hex) digests for text or files locally, with an uppercase toggle, line-by-line batch hashing and HMAC-MD5. MD5 is broken for security purposes; use it only for non-adversarial integrity checks and deduplication.

map.MD5 和 SHA 是什么关系？: What is the relationship between MD5 and SHA?
map.两者都是密码学哈希函数，但输出长度不同：MD5 128 位、SHA-1 160: Both are cryptographic hash functions but with different output lengths: MD5 128 bits, SHA-1 160 bits, SHA-256 256 bits. MD5 has been broken; use SHA-256 or stronger where security matters.
map.MD5 主循环：把填充后的消息按 32 位字分组，每轮 64 步依次调用四个非线: MD5 main loop: the padded message is grouped into 32-bit words; each round of 64 steps calls four nonlinear functions in turn — F = (b & c) | (~b & d), G = (b & d) | (c & ~d), H = b ^ c ^ d, I = c ^ (b | ~d) — and each step computes a = rotate-left(a + function value + message word + constant, shift amount) + b, rotating the roles a→d→c→b. Message-word indices use a different order per round: round one 0…15 in sequence, round two (1+5i) mod 16, round three (5+3i) mod 16, round four (7i) mod 16; the rotate amounts for the four rounds are 7/12/17/22, 5/9/14/20, 4/11/16/23, and 6/10/15/21, and the constants are ⌊2³²·|sin(i+1)|⌋. Finally the four registers are concatenated in little-endian byte order into a 128-bit digest and converted to hex
